story: In the diverse world of birds, the Northen Hawk Owl (Surnia ulula) stands out. This species, part of the Strigidae family, is a resident of Dense coniferous or mixed forests adjoining open areas; pine forest; birch woodland; and tundra edges. Its IUCN Red List status is Least Concern (LC), which serves as a call to action for habitat preservation. The Northen Hawk Owl is more than just a bird; it is a symbol of the rich biodiversity that we must protect. Through this poster, we hope to foster a greater understanding and appreciation for the Northen Hawk Owl and its role in the ecosystem.
Every poster is crafted to inspire curiosity about our planet's incredible biodiversity.
